zh.title: 越南航空波音787客機慕尼黑起飛異常擦尾降落
zh.summary: 越南航空787客機於慕尼黑起飛時發生加速異常與擦尾，放油返航降落無人受傷。
body: 越南航空（Vietnam Airlines）一架波音（Boeing）787-9客機於2026年8月15日執行由德國慕尼黑機場（MUC）飛往河內的VN34航班時，在起飛滑跑過程中發生加速度異常與擦尾事件。根據越南民用航空局（CAAV）公布的初步資訊，機組員在起飛滑跑途中注意到飛行加速度出現異常變化。
飛行員報告指出，當該架機號為VN-A867的客機滑行至26L跑道約一半位置時，飛機曾停止加速約兩秒。隨後飛機重新開始加速並達到起飛決定速度（V1），但機組員緊接著再度察覺速度下降。由於剩餘跑道長度已不足以安全放棄起飛，機組員遂將推力桿推至最大並繼續起飛作業。根據初步報告，飛行員在跑道僅剩約300英呎時開始拉桿抬頭起飛。
飛機離地升空後，機組員接獲擦尾警報以及胎壓異常警報。由於該班機載有前往河內長途飛行所需的燃料，機組員隨即向空中交通管制通報並決定返回慕尼黑機場。客機在完成空中放油後，於起飛後約兩小時安全降落於26R跑道。
事後檢查發現，該客機主起落架的八條輪胎中有四條失去壓力，且機尾下方機身結構出現與擦尾相符的損壞痕跡。現場照片與影片顯示跑道末端延伸至鋪面外留有長條輪胎煞車痕。該航班當時載有271名乘客與16名機組人員，事件中無人受傷。德國聯邦航空事故調查局（BFU）已取得飛航紀錄器與駕駛艙語音記錄器，目前正就起飛加速異常與煞車系統等原因展開調查。

en.title: Vietnam Airlines Boeing 787-9 Suffers Acceleration Issue and Tail Strike in Munich
en.summary: Vietnam Airlines Boeing 787-9 experienced acceleration issues and tail strike during takeoff from Munich, returning safely.
body: A Vietnam Airlines Boeing 787-9 aircraft experienced an abnormal change in acceleration and a tail strike during its takeoff roll from Munich Airport (MUC) in Germany on August 15, 2026. According to preliminary information released by the Civil Aviation Authority of Vietnam (CAAV), Flight VN34 was departing from Munich bound for Hanoi when the flight crew noticed speed fluctuations during the takeoff attempt.

The pilots reported that while approximately halfway down Runway 26L, the aircraft ceased accelerating for about two seconds before resuming acceleration. Upon reaching V1, the takeoff decision speed, the crew observed a second decrease in speed. With insufficient runway distance remaining to safely abort the departure, the crew advanced the thrust levers to maximum power and continued, initiating rotation with only about 300 feet of runway remaining.

After getting airborne, the crew received automated alerts indicating a tail strike and abnormal tire pressure. Because the widebody aircraft was carrying a heavy fuel load intended for the long-haul flight to Hanoi, the pilots executed a fuel dump over designated airspace before electing to return to Munich Airport . The aircraft landed safely on Runway 26R approximately two hours after takeoff.

A post-flight inspection confirmed that four of the eight main landing gear tires had lost pressure, alongside structural damage to the underside of the aft fuselage consistent with a tail strike. Scene imagery revealed long tire skid marks extending toward and beyond the departure end of the runway. The aircraft, registered as VN-A867, was carrying 271 passengers and 16 crew members, with no injuries reported. Germany's Federal Bureau of Aircraft Accident Investigation (BFU) has secured the flight data recorder and cockpit voice recorder for technical analysis in Braunschweig.

zh.title: 馬來西亞航空完成全體機師強制藥檢 擴大至客艙組員
zh.summary: 馬來西亞航空完成全體機師強制藥檢；結果均為陰性；即日起擴大至客艙組員
body: 馬來西亞航空母公司馬來西亞航空集團（MAG）宣布，已全面完成對馬來西亞航空所有在勤機師的強制性藥物篩檢。這項檢測為集團推動的加強安全與執勤適任性措施之一，成功趕在公司自行設定的2026年8月15日截止日期前完成。集團指出，100%營運中活性機師均已接受篩檢，所有檢測結果均呈陰性反應。
MAG總裁兼集團執行長納薩魯丁·巴卡爾機長（Captain Nasaruddin A. Bakar）表示，完成機師階段的篩檢是重要的里程碑，但相關工作仍未結束。集團正將藥物篩檢擴大至其他營運部門，以確保整個航空集團貫徹相同的嚴格標準。自2026年8月18日起，第二階段篩檢已正式啟動，預計覆蓋馬來西亞航空約2,840名客艙組員，目標是在2026年9月3日前完成全面檢測。
同屬MAG集團的姐妹航空公司飛螢航空（Firefly）亦同步執行機師與客艙組員的藥物篩檢作業。截至2026年8月15日，飛螢航空158名機師及163名客艙組員中已有超過半數接受檢測，目前的結果均為陰性。飛螢航空預計在2026年8月25日前完成其餘員工的篩檢，此進度提前於馬來西亞民航局（CAAM）所設定的2026年9月5日監管截止日期。

MAG集團表示，這項強制性藥物篩檢計畫於2026年8月6日正式啟動，起因於馬來西亞航空一名副駕駛（second officer）先前在印度尼西亞遭逮捕。該名副駕駛於2026年7月28日搭乘馬來西亞航空MH727航班自吉隆坡飛抵雅加達後，遭印尼海關人員查獲行李內藏有約25公斤的搖頭丸與冰毒，涉嫌走私毒品。馬來西亞航空澄清，該員當時是以觀察員身份坐在駕駛艙折疊椅（jump seat）隨機搭乘，並非執行飛行任務的機師，且在該事件發生前已有兩天處於休假狀態。

針對該起事件，馬來西亞民航局（CAAM）已展開獨立的監管調查，重點釐清該名機師在吉隆坡國際機場（KUL）出境前，相關單位是否嚴格執行航空安全檢查程序。CAAM執行長諾拉茲曼·馬哈茂德機長（Datuk Captain Norazman Mahmud）指出，機組人員並不豁免於標準機場安檢，進入安全管制區時必須接受與其他人相同的檢查。同時，馬來西亞警方亦啟動平行刑事調查，調閱監視器畫面與行李篩檢紀錄，並與印尼當局保持合作。此外，MAG集團也表示，安全與健康團隊將維持常態性的抽檢計畫，並持續與民航主管機關合作。

en.title: Malaysia Airlines Completes Mandatory Drug Screening for All Active Pilots
en.summary: Malaysia Airlines completes mandatory pilot drug screening with all negative results; expands testing to cabin crew.
body: Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) has announced the completion of mandatory drug screening for all active Malaysia Airlines pilots, meeting an internal deadline set for August 15, 2026. The testing initiative was conducted as part of enhanced safety and fitness-for-duty measures across the group's airlines. According to MAG, 100 percent of the carrier's operationally active pilots were screened, and every test returned a negative result.

Captain Nasaruddin A. Bakar, President and Group Chief Executive Officer of MAG, called the completion of the pilot screening phase an important milestone, emphasizing that safety remains central to company decisions. MAG is now advancing to the next phase of its program, which targets approximately 2,840 Malaysia Airlines cabin crew members. That screening phase began on August 18, 2026, and is scheduled to be progressively expanded through September 3, 2026.

The drug testing program is also progressing at MAG's sister airline, Firefly, encompassing both pilots and cabin crew personnel. As of August 15, 2026, more than half of Firefly's 158 pilots and 163 cabin crew members had completed the screening, with all test results coming back negative. Firefly remains on track to finish testing for its remaining operational workforce by August 25, 2026, well ahead of the September 5, 2026 deadline established by the Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia (CAAM).

MAG launched the mandatory screening program on August 6, 2026, following the arrest of a Malaysia Airlines second officer in Indonesia on alleged drug trafficking charges. The incident occurred on July 28, 2026, when Indonesian customs authorities detained the pilot after flight MH727 arrived in Jakarta from Kuala Lumpur, allegedly finding around 25 kilograms of ecstasy pills and methamphetamine concealed in the individual's luggage. Malaysia Airlines noted that the employee was off duty and traveling in the cockpit jump seat as an observer rather than operating the aircraft.

In response to the breach, the Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia (CAAM) initiated a regulatory investigation to evaluate whether all mandatory aviation security procedures were properly enforced at Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KUL) prior to departure. CAAM Chief Executive Datuk Captain Norazman Mahmud confirmed that flight crews are required to undergo standard security checks before entering restricted areas. Malaysian police simultaneously launched a criminal investigation reviewing airport surveillance tapes and baggage screening records in cooperation with Indonesian authorities, while MAG's Safety and Health team intends to maintain ongoing random testing.

zh.title: 美國FAA宣布Electra與州政府完成油電混合飛行展示
zh.summary: Electra與美州政府合作，完成連結地方與樞紐機場的油電混合展示飛行。
body: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）宣布，航太製造商 Electra、賓夕法尼亞州交通廳與紐澤西州交通廳合作，順利完成了油電混合動力飛機的展示飛行。此次測試旨在驗證連接地方小型機場與大型樞紐機場航線的可行性。
本次展示飛行屬於 FAA 的「電動垂直起降整合試點計畫」（eIPP）的一環，航線自維吉尼亞州馬納薩斯起飛，終點為費城。飛機沿途停靠了華盛頓馬納薩斯機場（PNE）、米爾維爾執行機場、大西洋城貝德機場及東北費城機場，最後抵達費城國際機場。
FAA 表示，此計畫收集的資料將協助建立連接鄉村與大都會地區的飛航系統。美國交通部已於 2026 年 3 月選定 8 個計畫參與 eIPP，相關單位預計於今年底前持續進行更多測試。

en.title: FAA Announces Hybrid-Electric Flight Demonstrations Connecting Local and Hub Airports
en.summary: Electra and US transportation departments conduct hybrid-electric demonstration flights connecting small and major airports.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced that Electra, the Pennsylvania Department of Transportation, and the New Jersey Department of Transportation have conducted hybrid-electric demonstration flights. The tests evaluated routes connecting small local airports with major airline hubs.

As part of the FAA's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP), the flights took place between Manassas, Virginia, and Philadelphia. The aircraft made stops at Washington Manassas Airport, Millville Executive Airport, Atlantic City Bader Field, Northeast Philadelphia Airport (PNE), and Philadelphia International Airport.

According to the FAA, the data gathered will help design a system to connect rural and metropolitan areas. The Department of Transportation selected eight eIPP projects in March 2026, and participants plan further test flights this year.
